interface.shortDescription: Start it right, in this folder
interface.longDescription: OwlMeans builds SaaS applications and AI agents, with the chatbots and data pipelines around them, on a specialized AI development pipeline: it turns a plain-language description into a full-stack application (a web interface, an API and a background worker) and keeps developing it one user story at a time. This plugin runs the OwlMeans MCP server on your computer: the platform generates the code in the cloud and the server writes the project into the folder Codex works in, where it can also be built and started. Generation and development spend credits from your OwlMeans account; billing, plans and credit top-ups stay in the OwlMeans web app. Actions that cannot be undone ask for confirmation first.
